notes: Contraction paired with mathematics-replace-0001: removes the revision's original fact, 'The Elements ... was written by Euclid' (functional relation written_by). Mathematics leaves out worlds. Questions and evidence about the original fact come from the revision. Near is the inverse reading (written_by is the inverse of author_of); far reaches Euclid through the description 'the author of the Elements' and a stored fact about the man (Alexandria). The cardinality question asks another candidate author (Pythagoras), 'no' before because a work has one author, and 'I don't know' after; Pythagoras was picked because nobody writes the denial of his authorship of the Elements, to be confirmed by the counts. The two 2-hop questions go through the removed fact by description, 'the author of the Elements', and use facts stated about Euclid by name (the Euclidean algorithm, the Optics); the old derived questions about 'father of geometry' and the prime proof were dropped because 'Euclid's theorem' and 'father of geometry' tie those facts to the Elements itself.
